reviews.author: jangwon choi
reviews.text:
Somang Church is about a 10-minute walk from Exit 3 of Apgujeong Station.
Somang Church is near Shingu Middle School, and next to the church there is a missionary center and an education center.
On the way back, I saw Apgujeong 1-dong Cathedral nearby.

Sunday service started at 11:30, so I arrived around 11 and entered the main church.
Since this place has a lot of church members, there are quite a few people volunteering to park there.
Nearby, there is a parking lot at Shingu Middle School and the building in front of the church.
Sunday services are at 7:30 a.m., 9:30 a.m., 11:30 a.m., 1:30 p.m., and 3:30 p.m.
A total of 5 worship services will be held, with a praise service held at 7:30 p.m.

Since it is a fairly large church in Gangnam, there seem to be quite a lot of attendees.
Like Gwanglim Church, here, too, the social service center provides services to registered members of Somang Church.
We provide legal, tax, labor, and welfare consulting services.
In addition to the senior pastor, Pastor Gyeongjin Kim, there are 21 associate pastors.
Although it is smaller than Gwanglim Church, it has a lot of ministers.

The church was founded in 1977, starting with Pastor Seonhee Kwak's three-day prayer meeting.
The temple was built at its current location in 1981, and a dedication service was held in 1982.
It is said that the extension dedication service was held in 1987.
After Pastor Kwak Seon-hee, Pastor Kim Ji-cheol took over in 2003.
It is said that the current Pastor Kyungjin Kim was commissioned as senior pastor in 2019.

At 11:30, there is a three-part service, and the number of people in the Zion Choir is over 100.
There appear to be about 15 orchestra members singing together.
Because the church is large, the pipe organ is also placed in the front of the chapel.

reviews.author: Cindy Li
reviews.text:
I was really impressed by the attitude of the employees at this store. In the review, some people compared this golf brand to Hermes... Are you talking about the overbearing attitude of the employees? I have never had such an unpleasant experience at an Hermes store. Isn’t there a law that says customers have to buy something just because they enter the store? I was just calling an Uber from the store, but I kept getting noticed and urged. If I don't consume, am I not allowed to stay indoors? This is a policy that is difficult to understand. There are many golf brands in the world, so there is no reason to buy from such an unfriendly place. From now on, I think today’s experience will come to mind every time I see this brand. In short, this is a place I would never recommend again.
The staff at this store left quite an impression — unfortunately, for all the wrong reasons. I saw some reviews comparing this golf brand to Hermès… were they referring to the arrogance of the service? Because not even at Hermès have I experienced such unprofessional and unwelcoming behavior. Just because a customer walks into the store doesn’t mean they’re obligated to make a purchase. I was simply calling an Uber inside, yet I was repeatedly pressured to leave. Does this store have an unspoken policy that forbids non-buyers from standing indoors?

There are countless golf brands out there, and after today, I have no reason to ever choose this one again. Every time I come across this brand, I’ll remember how unpleasant this visit was. In short: not a place I would recommend — unless you’re looking to be reminded how not to treat customers.

reviews.author: jin baram
reviews.text:
I signed a rental contract at Ministro’s main branch.
Transportation was convenient, the store was clean, there were friendly consultants, and various colored suits were available for fitting. I signed a contract with British fabric because I thought it was thick and wouldn't wrinkle easily, and I rented 2 sets for the photo shoot day and 1 set for the actual day. I selected the photo shoot suit right away, and plan to go two months before the main ceremony and select again for the main ceremony. We plan to pick it up after 4pm the day before the shoot.

reviews.author: Bear
reviews.text: I met Ministro at a wedding fair, set a date, and went to the main store. The main branch is located on the first basement level of The Pinnacle Gangnam, next to Exit 3 of Gangnam-gu Office Station. I rarely wear suits, so I was worried about what to do and what to choose for my wedding attire, but when I visited, I found that the clothes were available in a variety of colors, sizes, and styles, and the person in charge explained each one in detail and kindly, so I was able to comfortably choose the attire I wanted. Although the main character of a wedding is the bride wearing a wedding dress, the attire of her partner, the groom, is also very important! I rented a suit for a studio shoot and had a great time shooting it. I'll be returning soon to get measurements for a custom suit! I would like to recommend Minist to my friends who are getting married. May you prosper!

reviews.author: Jiyeon Kim
reviews.text: I found out about Ministro through a wedding fair~ I was introduced to the person in charge of Yongsoo Kim, and was able to customize and rent it with ease thanks to his kind and detailed explanations~ You can feel the long experience of person in charge Yongsoo Kim~ I recommend it~ My boyfriend and I think we will use it often because the fit is perfect~!!!! The price is reasonable and transportation is directly connected to the subway station, so take the escalade and go!
